entities.name: St. Elmo's fire
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: St. Elmo's fire is a weather phenomenon in which luminous plasma is created by a corona discharge from a rod-like object such as a mast, spire, chimney, or animal horn in an atmospheric electric field. It has also been observed on the leading edges of aircraft and by US Air Force pilots.
